text: RLS updates the inverse-correlation matrix P using the ___ formula (a rank-1 update), so no explicit matrix inversion is needed at each step.
explanation: Both esn.py and the book identify the rank-1 Sherman-Morrison identity (a special case of the Woodbury / matrix-inversion lemma) as the tool that lets P be updated in O(N^2) without ever inverting an N x N matrix.
